summary: Mokashi et al. 2021, 10x scRNA-seq of adult brains of wild-type Canton S (B) flies reared on reference or ethanol-supplemented medium (GEO GSE172231); replaces the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0005420 with fresh VFBseq ids. Reference-medium samples only: 4 Samples / 4 Assays (2 sexes x 2 replicates). One Clustering with the authors' 43 clusters (all 8 samples integrated, resolution 0.9) restricted to the 56,165 reference cells, from the authors' complete per-cell table in SCEA (E-GEOD-172231.cells.txt): 26 loaded (adult neurotransmitter-class and cell-type terms), 17 held. Summary expression as CPM from the reference libraries' GEO matrices (17,448 genes x 56,165 cells).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held).
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.

Narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the tissue-specific FBbt term exact; hold clusters that could only be typed as cell or neuron (or stage-specific versions); load glia under a glial-cell term.
Reference-medium samples only (as the old load); the authors' 43 clusters, made with all 8 samples, restricted to the reference cells.

Samples: one per GSM (20 pooled brains, one 10x library); adult stage (3-5 days post-eclosion; no FBdv term covers days 3-5 only); adult brain; sex from GEO; Canton S (B), no stock named (not linked).

Per-cell clusters from the authors' complete per-cell table in SCEA's FTP folder (E-GEOD-172231.cells.txt; all 104,984 cells the authors' script's filters keep, every sample equal), typed by the authors' own 'Inferred cell type' (SCEA's standardised label kept as author_scea_label). SCEA's experiment-design download covers only the cells SCEA's own reprocessing kept. A re-run of the authors' script (Seurat 3.2.3 / sctransform 0.3.2, CRAN snapshot 2021-01-15, on a 240 GB VFB server) gave 34 clusters, not 43 (ARI 0.72 against the authors' labels; pairs of their clusters merged), so it was not used.

Mapping per author type (shared calls with Baker 2021): adult neurotransmitter-class terms ('... of central brain' to the class); 5-HT and DA neurons to adult aminergic neuron (broad); adult astrocyte-like glial cell, Kenyon cell, olfactory projection neuron, optic lobe neuron, eye photoreceptor cell, adult brain surface glial cell (brain-only dissection: exact); Tachykinin/neuropeptidergic neurons to adult peptidergic neuron (broad, corrected after review); ellipsoid / fan-shaped body cells to adult central complex neuron (broad); 'Neuropeptides in perhaps cholinergic neurons' to adult peptidergic neuron. Held: mixed-structure clusters, the authors' undetermined hedges, 'Neuropeptides/cholinergic neurons' (co-expression not stated; curator: two terms only where stated, else hold), 'Developmental genes'.

Expression from the four reference libraries' GEO matrices side by side (combine_matrices.py), as CPM; the features are FlyBase annotation ids from the authors' NCBI GenBank reference (Dmel_CG...), mapped to genes in Chado (update_gene_ids.py features_keyed_by: annotation_id): 17,451 current, 3 merges, 30 dropped.
All mapping.tsv rows reviewed by the curator (mapping.tsv `reviewed`).
